description: This bar chart, from the paper “Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis,” illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis models—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two distinct tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis lists the two tweet categories. For each category, three bars are displayed side-by-side, representing the respective models. In the “Emoji Tweets” category, the TEXTBLOB model (hatched gray bar) achieves an accuracy of approximately 0.4, the VADER model (solid green bar) achieves approximately 0.7, and the ChatGPT model (hatched gray bar with a green outline) achieves approximately 0.6. In the “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis” category, the TEXTBLOB model achieves approximately 0.6, the VADER model achieves approximately 0.8, and the ChatGPT model achieves approximately 0.8. The bars are not sorted by height; instead, they are presented in the order specified by the legend, which indicates that TEXTBLOB is represented by a hatched pattern, VADER by a solid green fill, and ChatGPT by a hatched pattern with a green outline. The chart includes a legend in the upper right quadrant that explicitly links each model to its corresponding visual representation.
